charles.about: The plan: 80% SPY (a 2x S&P fund while calm and rising) + 4 momentum stocks at 5%, all to T-bills when SPY ends a month below its 200-day average

charles_sectors.about: Same plan, but the momentum picks are sector funds (no survivor bias)

spy_trend_only.about: Only the safety switch: 99% SPY or T-bills, checked monthly

charles_no_switch.about: The plan without the safety switch

charles_steady.about: The plan without aggressive mode (always plain SPY as the core)
